# Definition 
**The Copernican Turn** is a paradigmatic philosophical approach advanced by Immanuel Kant in the *Critique of Pure Reason* which argues that the innate structures of our mind play a stronger role in shaping our experiences and knowledge derived from experiences than do the objects of experience themselves.
